body:
| Concern | Pick |
|---|---|
| Build system | pnpm workspaces · tsup (packages) · Vite 6 (app) · CRXJS |
| Language | TypeScript 5.7 |
| UI | React 19 · Tailwind CSS v4 · shadcn / basecn primitives |
| Markdown | `react-markdown` (chosen over `@mdx-js/mdx` — see §5 CSP) + remark-gfm / remark-math / remark-breaks + rehype-raw / rehype-slug / rehype-katex |
| Code highlight | Shiki (core + JS regex engine, lazy per-language) |
| JSON tree | `@uiw/react-json-view` |
| Table | `@tanstack/react-table` + `@tanstack/react-virtual` + `papaparse` |
| Diagrams | Mermaid (lazy-loaded) |
| Math | KaTeX |
| Search | FlexSearch |
| Storage | `idb-keyval` (IndexedDB) |
| State | zustand |
| Manifest | MV3 with `host_permissions: ["<all_urls>"]` (bypasses CORS for remote CSV) |

---
